suffix: Shot like a real space-mission photograph: fine grain, one hard sunlight source, deep black space. No text, no lettering, no logos.
note: Round 3 (Kai 2026-11-03): extra orbit room for the last 20s; a much wider zoom-out than city/country, the whole Earth red.
rows: The whole Earth, red, satellite small

Using the reference only for the satellite's design, a far wider new picture: the satellite small in the near corner, and beyond it the entire globe of the Earth hanging in space, its whole night hemisphere netted in red light, every continent traced red, only a thin blue crescent of dawn on one edge.
Past the Moon: a red Earth

From beyond the Moon: the grey cratered limb of the Moon fills the bottom of frame, and far out in the black the Earth is a small disc whose night side glows red instead of gold, a thin crescent of daylight on its edge.
A ring of ships round the planet

The whole Earth seen from deep space, its dark side glowing red over every landmass, and around it a thin flat ring made of thousands of tiny white ship lights, circling the planet like the ring of Saturn.
